name: Remittance Location 9
definition: Provides information on the remittance advice.

RemittanceIdentification.name: Remittance Identification
RemittanceIdentification.definition: Unique identification, as assigned by the initiating party, to unambiguously identify the remittance information sent separately from the payment instruction, such as a remittance advice.

RemittanceLocationMethod.name: Remittance Location Method
RemittanceLocationMethod.definition: Method used to deliver the remittance advice information.

RemittanceLocationElectronicAddress.name: Remittance Location Electronic Address
RemittanceLocationElectronicAddress.definition: Electronic address to which an agent is to send the remittance information.

RemittanceLocationPostalAddress.name: Remittance Location Postal Address
RemittanceLocationPostalAddress.definition: Postal address to which an agent is to send the remittance information.
